About

A life at the
intersection

"I've been ordained three times, worked in famine-affected communities, built wellness startups, and somehow ended up explaining Buddhist philosophy to 12,000 people on TikTok. This is what the path looks like."

AJ Kim is a Buddhist educator, humanitarian, author, and coach working at the intersection of contemplative wisdom, social impact, and modern life. Based in Toronto, her work spans three continents and three Buddhist traditions.

First ordained at 19 by one of Korea's most respected Buddhist leaders, Venerable Pomnyun, she spent three years as a postulant and has since deepened her practice across the Plum Village tradition in Thailand and the Theravāda forest tradition rooted in Myanmar.

Alongside her contemplative training, AJ brings over a decade of experience in social entrepreneurship, community development, and humanitarian field work — from leading Korea's pioneering mindfulness startup Mind Ground, to documentary work across the Global South, to facilitating wellbeing programs with communities in Ghana, Tanzania, and India.

She is the author of Dear Dharma: Buddhist-ish Modern Wisdom for a Complicated World, and the founder of Wisdomway Impact, a registered Canadian NGO.

AJ brings a rare combination to any stage: genuine contemplative depth, on-the-ground humanitarian experience, and the ability to make complex ideas land without losing their edge.

She has spoken at universities, conferences, and community events across Asia, Africa, and North America — and holds an audience with the confidence of someone who has tested these ideas in real communities, not just classrooms.
